res = action(['RIGHT'])
print("result:", res.get('board_changed'), res.get('gameplay_changed'), res.get('no_impact'))
def ob(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'O':
            b = n['boundary']
            return (min(p[0] for p in b), min(p[1] for p in b))
print("O now:", ob(current_frame))
for i, ent in enumerate(last_animation):
    seen = []
    for f in ent.frames:
        pos = None
        for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
            if n['color'] == 'O':
                b = n['boundary']
                pos = (min(p[0] for p in b), min(p[1] for p in b))
        if pos not in seen:
            seen.append(pos)
    print("  path:", seen)
# check g balls still present
gs = [(n['color'], min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']), min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])) for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='g']
print("g balls:", gs)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
